WITH team_totals AS (
    SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games
    FROM home_game
    GROUP BY team_id
), ratios AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        total_home_games,
        total_home_games * 1.0 / SUM(total_home_games) OVER () AS fraction_of_all,
        total_home_games * 1.0 / AVG(total_home_games) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
    FROM team_totals
)
SELECT team_id, total_home_games, fraction_of_all, ratio_to_average
FROM ratios
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Teams with no home_game rows are excluded because the request asks for teams in home_game; SUM ignores NULL games values.
